title: A schema for a bus-replacement snapshot
heading: One Schema Validates the Whole Snapshot and Reports Every Problem in One Pass
cases: a clean snapshot is accepted, and one that lists a bus twice is refused, naming the bus
a bus kept at a depot the snapshot does not list is refused, naming the bus
a year of the horizon with no budget row is refused, naming the year
a year with two budget rows is refused too: each year has exactly one
a snapshot with two problems across records names both in one error
a window whose earliest year is after its latest is refused; a one-year window is fine
a year may have a budget of zero, but not a negative one
a replacement bus must cost something
